story: Drop the safe-area round trip (and its SafeAreaView root) and hand the transcript the floating composer's height directly, so its bottom inset follows the composer without an extra layout pass.
defect: TranscriptViewController now takes `composerHeight` — geometry describing its sibling, the composer — which SessionTabViewController feeds from composer.view.frame in viewDidLayout, instead of the container setting the transcript's own safe area (additionalSafeAreaInsets) and the transcript honouring it like any scroll view.
rule: macos/CLAUDE.md § Component boundaries — B1: a component takes no geometry that describes something else ("the space the composer covers"); overlap is the container's business via the child's safe area
hit: Says TranscriptViewController exposes/takes a composerHeight (a sibling's geometry) set by SessionTabViewController from the composer's frame, instead of using additionalSafeAreaInsets / its own safe area.
